Class ClientMetadataService

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.mcp.oauth.ClientMetadataService
@Service @ConditionalOnProperty(prefix="gt.use", name="mcp", havingValue="true") public class ClientMetadataService extends Object
Identifies OAuth clients by their Client ID Metadata Document: the client_id is an HTTPS URL, and the JSON document behind it names the client and its redirect URIs. GT offers no dynamic client registration, so this is the only way a client becomes known.

A document is accepted when its client_id equals the URL it was loaded from, the client can work without a client secret and every redirect URI is HTTPS or HTTP to a loopback address. A client that lists several methods in token_endpoint_auth_methods_supported qualifies when none is among them, whatever its preferred method in token_endpoint_auth_method; ChatGPT, for example, prefers private_key_jwt and also offers none, which GT's metadata announce as the only method. Without that list the single method must be none or absent. The documents are fetched through ClientMetadataFetcher, whose default refuses private addresses.

The load on foreign servers is bounded for the whole instance, not only per fetch: at most 200 results are cached for an hour, failures included, and at most four fetches run at the same time.
